In detail

Casal Bruciato is a dense public-housing (ATER) district that has repeatedly made Rome crime news. A 2018 murder (a man shot dead outside his home, described by police as a settling of scores) is the most serious documented incident, but shootings have recurred since, including gunfire near a school that alarmed residents and prompted the local mini-mayor to publicly call for more security. Local outlets have also reported an escalation of street robberies and muggings with at least four women targeted in a few days, along with car arsons, and residents have organised citizen street patrols in response. This is one of the most consistently documented problem areas in Municipio IV, warranting a red rating at night, with a yellow rating by day given the reported daytime street robberies.
